description: A bottle of cough syrup drunk for entirely the wrong reason. Cheap, legal, and a long way down.

effects.comeon_message: It's thick and far too sweet. You sit down to wait, and it takes a long time.

events.text: [trip]Your limbs get heavy and slightly further away than they were.[/trip]
[trip]You stand up and your body follows the plan a moment late, like a bad dub.[/trip]
[trip]The plateau. Everything is very far off and none of it is urgent.[/trip]
[trip]Sound arrives in slabs. You have been listening to the same second for a while.[/trip]
[trip]Something in the room has been waiting for you to notice it and is being patient.[/trip]
[trip]You start the long walk back up. It takes most of an evening.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your legs feel far away. You move a half-second after you mean to.

overdose.message: Your heart races and your breathing slows, until both stop.

phases.comedown_message: Your legs start doing what you tell them again.
phases.end_message: You're back in your body. Your jaw aches and you can still taste the syrup.

effects.take_line: You drink the whole bottle of {name}, gagging on the sweetness.

withdrawal.message: Everything is too sharp and too fast. You want to feel numb again.

stages.easing: You come down slowly and land on your feet.
stages.onset: The distance goes. Everything's within arm's reach again.
stages.peak: Nothing feels far away any more. It's all happening right in front of you.
stages.rising: Sounds are loud and clear and right here.
stages.tail: Everything feels close. You're mostly used to it.

name: robo
